name: Development
overview: Scripture reveals that development is a God-ordained process involving growth in responsibility, wisdom, and spiritual maturity. From the creation mandate to be fruitful and exercise dominion (Genesis 1:28), to Jesus’ own growth in wisdom and favor (Luke 2:52), development encompasses both physical and spiritual dimensions. Believers are called to persevere faithfully without turning back (Luke 9:62) and to continue in good works and knowledge of God (Galatians 6:9; Colossians 1:10), while using their speech to edify others and minister grace (Ephesians 4:29). This holistic growth honors God and reflects a life increasingly conformed to His will.
